model.name: RbFeatureManagerDetail.mount
model.description: mount(): LOAD-BEARING render/open of the FeatureManager view. connectedCallback -> GET /api/feature-manager -> renders each Feature + its allowedUsers + an add-user (grant) input + a per-user revoke button. Mounts in the DEFAULT DRAWER via the shared R31.4 detail-flow (RbDetailDrawer, DRY - no overlay/capture-hook/new-drawer). Owner-only (requireFeatureAccess). Mirror of RbTerminalDetail.mount 386cc4e4. Input-parse / list-build = private helpers (not Methods). Expert marks [impl:uuid] on the mount decl (#126). Architect topology 0e6fe16c0.
model.supersededNote: Superseded by the native scenario-unit itemView tree (Tron maximally-DRY reframe, R31.8 AC-featuremanager-view): Features render via the EXISTING itemView by a thin CHAIN_TYPE_CONFIG Feature entry (scenarioFwd:['allowedUsers']) -> /api/trace/children resolves allowedUsers as child nodes natively — no bespoke mount-as-list, no listFeatures API-reshape. Retired one-uuid-one-identity (kept on disk, removed from live arrays). Architect reconciliation 8916e33a5.
